title: Hitting time mixing for random $k$-cycles
summary: In this paper, we study the random walk on the symmetric group $\mathfrak{S}_n$ generated by the conjugacy class of $k$-cycles, where $2\le k=o(n/(\log n)^4)$. We prove that the walk exhibits hitting-time mixing: at the first time when every card has been touched, the distribution is already close to equilibrium. For odd $k$, the equilibrium measure is the uniform measure on $\mathfrak{A}_n$. For even $k$, the walk first mixes to the parity mixture determined by the hitting time, and in our range this mixture is asymptotically $U_{\mathfrak{S}_n}$.
